title: Which Israeli cabinet minister, if any, will unveil a named plan to remove Gaza's entire Palestinian population during the first week of September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by Israeli cabinet ministers, documented in contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Qualifying Event: Between September 1 and September 7, 2026, inclusive, a serving Israeli cabinet minister must publicly introduce an explicitly named plan for removing Gaza's Palestinian population from the territory. General endorsements of population removal or proposals for evacuating particular areas within Gaza do not qualify. Implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the minister's full name, or “None” if no qualifying announcement occurs.
last_rationale: specific wording suggests event; election campaign

title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
background: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes a monthly index tracking international prices across major food commodity categories.
resolution_criteria:
• Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-04
  • Answer with the category name.

title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.

title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
background: The opening goalscorer is the player officially credited with the first goal of the match.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.”
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

title: Which bank will the U.S. Treasury sanction over alleged financial ties to Iran during August 31–September 6, 2026?
background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official U.S. Treasury sanctions announcements and Office of Foreign Assets Control designation records.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the bank newly sanctioned during August 31–September 6, 2026, for allegedly facilitating financial transactions for Iran. Resolve when the Treasury publicly announces the designation.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The bank's commonly used name.

title: Which state will MAGA Inc. target with its first major general-election advertising buy of the 2026 midterms?
background: MAGA Inc. is a super PAC associated with Donald Trump. Its advertising commitments can indicate which congressional races Republicans consider strategically important.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: MAGA Inc.'s public announcement and corresponding Federal Election Commission filing, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the state targeted by the advertising commitment identified as MAGA Inc.'s first major general-election advertising expenditure of the 2026 midterm cycle. Resolution occurs when the commitment is publicly announced, regardless of when the advertisements begin running.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state where the advertisements are scheduled to run.

title: Which club will lead the La Liga table immediately after the Valencia–Barcelona match scheduled for September 20, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official La Liga standings or reputable contemporaneous match reports.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club occupying first place in the La Liga table immediately after the completion of Valencia's home match against Barcelona scheduled for September 20, 2026. Use the league's official ranking rules if clubs are level on points.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the name of the first-placed club.

title: Which DRC province will WHO identify as experiencing a surge in weekly Ebola cases in mid-September 2026?
background: The Democratic Republic of Congo declared an Ebola outbreak in May 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: WHO public statements about the DRC Ebola outbreak, including statements quoted in contemporaneous reputable news reporting.
  • Resolution Window: Resolve to the province explicitly identified by WHO as experiencing surging weekly Ebola cases in its outbreak assessment publicly reported between September 10 and September 16, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the province.

title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Italian Grand Prix?
background: The Italian Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship held at Monza.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The FIA's official race classification, supported by Formula One's official results.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the Italian Grand Prix scheduled for September 6, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The driver's name.

title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.

title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
background: The decennial US census affects representation in the House of Representatives and the allocation of federal funding. Trump has previously advocated changing which immigrants are counted.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official Department of Commerce proposal, or reliable contemporaneous reporting explicitly describing its eligibility rules for the 2030 census.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve upon the administration's next formal proposal specifying eligibility for the 2030 census, provided it is published by September 30, 2026. Identify the immigration status the proposal requires noncitizens to hold to be included. Publication is sufficient; implementation or judicial approval is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.

title: Who will control Yemen's Mayun Island on September 11, 2026?
background: Mayun, also known as Perim, is an island in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Its location makes it strategically important for maritime traffic.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press or Al Jazeera identifying which military actor exercises territorial control over Mayun Island.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve according to confirmed control on September 11, 2026. Territorial control means physical possession of the island, not merely a sovereignty claim or the ability to threaten nearby shipping.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.

title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the city.

title: Who will win the men's 5,000 metres at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest in September 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official results or contemporaneous reporting from a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the men's 5,000-metre final at the September 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The defendant's name as publicly reported.

title: Which U.S. player will advance furthest in men's singles at the 2026 US Open?
background: This question concerns the men's singles main draw, excluding qualifying.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the 2026 tournament.
  • Resolution: Identify the player representing the United States with the highest tournament finish. The champion ranks above the runner-up, followed by semifinalists, quarterfinalists, and earlier-round finishers. Resolve once no remaining match can change the identity of the uniquely highest-finishing U.S. player.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

title: Which film will win the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Venice Film Festival’s official announcement of its 2026 award winners.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the film awarded the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 festival, once the winner is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning film’s title.

title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 US Open?
background: The US Open is an annual Grand Slam tennis tournament played on hard courts in New York.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open tournament results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the player officially declared the women's singles champion following completion of the 2026 US Open final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The champion's full name.

title: Who will win the women's javelin title at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the athlete declared the women's javelin champion at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest, according to the official World Athletics results.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-19
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the athlete's full name.

title: Which club will win the Premier League match between Aston Villa and Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Premier League result or reliable contemporaneous match reports for Aston Villa versus Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the full-time result, including stoppage time.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name. If the match finishes level, indicate a draw.

title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.

title: Who will win the men's 200m at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled for September 11–13, 2026, in Budapest.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official World Athletics results, supported by contemporaneous reporting of the championship.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete who wins the men's 200m final at the 2026 Ultimate Championship, scheduled for September 11–13, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-25
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.

title: Who will win the men's javelin throw at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest, Hungary, in September 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official results for the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete awarded the men's javelin throw gold medal at the conclusion of the competition in September 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.
